2179. Remove Duplicate Elements Using Dynamic Memory Allocation

80

Hard

Problem Statement

Given an array of N integers, remove all duplicate elements while preserving the original order of the first occurrence.

You must use dynamic memory allocation and pointers to solve the problem.

Your program should:

Read N integers.

Dynamically allocate memory using  malloc() .

Pass the array address to a function named  removeDuplicates() .

Remove duplicate elements using pointer operations.

Return the updated size.

Print the resulting array.

Release dynamically allocated memory using  free() .
input_spec:
First line contains N.

Second line contains N integers.
output_spec:
4 2 3 5 6
